master:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: final production isolated transparent character master. Input image is the LOCKED NEXA state sheet; extract and finalize ONLY its central HAZIR character. Do NOT reinterpret design or style. A single Nexa centered on a square TRANSPARENT canvas, about 88 percent of canvas height, with safe transparent margins. True alpha, no checkerboard drawn into image, no text, no board, no other states, no background, no ground shadow, no habitat, no floating particles.
LOCKED IDENTITY: ivory white face region, small navy eyes with extremely modest highlight, tiny calm near-neutral mouth, cyan/turquoise/blue fluid digital entity without human body or limbs. The upper single directional curved crest and lower diagonal flowing wrap are essential. Keep the exact central ready reference face proportions, silhouette, direction and composition.
Final cleanup ONLY: slightly more MATTE, no bloom or glowing halo, fewer fine internal ribbons and no grainy texture. Broad blue/cyan/turquoise masses, soft restrained shading. Two or three main ribbons only, clear white face. No glass/plastic reflections, no glossy specular, no chibi/mascot/anime, no extra big eyes. Blue midtone boundaries remain visible on white and dark without changing character palette. No light source effects outside silhouette. All character material opaque except antialiased edge. Production clean edge, naturally asymmetric elegant reference geometry. Exactly one HAZIR Nexa.
